beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Openness keeps commitments revisable, while action prevents that openness from becoming paralysis.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That framework connects the intimate beginning with the triptych's larger speculative environments.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the short reading guide, then the city between day and night.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The people there provide a concrete center for the concepts that follow.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each spiral changes the power available to people trying to care for one another.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its strongest question concerns a future that love supports without owning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The repeated change of scale lets you compare intimacy with more powerful forms of care.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read the three spirals to test understanding against the freedom to remain different.
